name: La Vie en Fleur
source:
Eine Blume, a world blessed by flowers.

A girl who works at a flower shop in Yunefleur, the capital city, met a wounded boy in the forest.

However, hundreds of years ago, his ancestors and their blood relatives were cursed by the Flower Goddess. The "Kare Shisha" withered every flower they touched.

[Translated from [url=http://fleur0.starfree.jp/story.html]official website[/url]]
